frame.pixel_convention: zero-based pixel centres; GDAL affine receives centre + 0.5
notes: source reduced 10.5x onto the working grid and sampled without anti-aliasing; a filter wide enough to band-limit it costs more reads than the stage is worth

pixel_convention: zero-based pixel centres; world = GDAL affine * (x+0.5, y+0.5)
coordinates: `matrix` is in working-grid centre coordinates; `matrix_reference_px` is the same transform in full-resolution reference pixels. Both are residual corrections after metadata prealignment. For segmented exports use the complete blended inverse field, not the global matrix alone.

application.sampling: inverse matrix; plus the cubic B-spline correction in `local_field`, evaluated at the working-grid reference position
